results.notes: Slow pass: one timed run (no warmup for JVM, Ruby, PHP and Dart), in the same batch as the other rows. Nothing is verified by default: the library hands the app RelayResponseEvent objects whose ->event is the json_decode()d stdClass. The harness calls the library's Event::verify($stdClass) on each one (field types, id = sha256 of json_encode([0,...], JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES|JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), then the BIP-340 signature via paragonie/ecc) and drops the events it rejects. transmit() blocks in the WebSocket client's listen loop and calls onReceive for every frame; the callback pauses the connection on EOSE (the library never stops on its own). PersistentConnection also keeps every RelayResponse in an array for the life of the connection. Teardown ignores the ConnectionFailureException that PersistentConnection::close() throws on some runs (it disconnects, then sends a close frame on the closed connection). Config: the WebSocket client's read timeout (default 60 s) is raised to --timeout-ms so a slow download is not cut short; otherwise defaults.

The harness calls the library's Event::verify($stdClass) on each one (field types, id = sha256 of json_encode([0,...], JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES|JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), then the BIP-340 signature via paragonie/ecc) and drops the events it rejects. Request::send() reads until EOSE, sends CLOSE, disconnects and returns the responses; EOSE reaches the app when send() returns, and the events are verified after it.
